title: Karnak uniforms and the dream of joining Armstrong
summary: Joe Glaser sent Moore to the Karnak tailor for three uniforms; he remembers the Sunset Cafe days as he went to join Louis.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: Where was his place of business?
Karnak was at 48th and 7th Avenue, the second floor. So I went up and in the morning they measured for three sets of uniforms --
What were their colors, by the way? What color were the suits?
One was sky-blue, another was dark blue with white buttons and another was gray, gray slacks and a gray coat.

When I was on my way to New York to join Louis Armstrong, it brought back memories of my early years in 1929 when I was 17, I guess Louis was 29, considering that he was born with the century, 1900, and it was an ironic occasions for me to go join Louis because at that time when I was 17 I never dreamed that some day I would be in the Armstrong band. I was on my way to my dream coming true. No more fantasizing and I'm on my way to join Louie. So

At this point when they asked me to come to join Louis, many times I've thought about the times in front of the Sunset, when I was 17 years old, and Louis was 29. I never dreamed I would be with Louis Armstrong. It was a privileged opportunity. It was great to be asked to join the band. When they-----left St. Louis, I was in St. Louis for a week, and Joe Glaser called me to come in. So I came into New York and I talked to Joe and Joe said go to Karnak and fit yourself. Karnak will build you some uniforms.
